Tiana’s beignets
● 1 1/4 cups evaporated milk, warmed to 110°F
● 1/3 cup sugar
● 4 tbsp melted butter
● 1 large egg + 1 yolk
● 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
● 1 tsp salt
● 1/4 tsp cinnamon
● 1/4 tsp nutmeg
● 1 packet instant yeast
● 4 - 4 1/2 cups bread flour
● Honey, for drizzling
● Powdered sugar, for dusting

1. Combine milk, sugar, melted butter, egg, egg yolk, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, and yeast in the bowl of a stand mixer using a whisk.
2. Add 4 cups of flour and mix with a wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms.
3. Attach the dough hook to the mixer and knead the dough for 4 to 5 minutes until smooth. If the dough is too sticky, add up to a half cup more flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, until the dough pulls away from the sides and is slightly sticky.
4. Cover the bowl with a tea towel and proof in a warm place for one to two hours until doubled in size.
